ko: MY TONGUE IS HANGING OUT. THE SHOE TONGUE.
I HAVE BEEN DOUBLE KNOTTED.
THE SOLE LEAVES THE BODY.
MY INSOLE IS EXPOSED. THIS IS SO EMBARRASSING.
DO NOT LOOK AT MY ARCHES. THEY ARE PRIVATE.
I SMELL MY OWN HAT. I DESERVE THIS.
THIS HAT HAS SEEN TWO MARATHONS AND A GYM SHOWER.
MY HAT IS A SIZE TEN. MY HEAD IS A SIZE SIX.
TELL SENSEI I TRIPPED ON MY OWN LACES.
I DISHONOR MY FAMILY. AND THEIR FOOTWEAR.
I HAVE BROUGHT SHAME ON THE SHOE.
I AM BEING RECALLED BY THE MANUFACTURER.
RETURN ME TO THE STORE. I STILL HAVE THE BOX.
WHY DID I EVER PUT A FOOT THING ON MY HEAD.
MY SPORK IS BENT. MY SPIRIT IS BENT. MY BACK IS BENT.
THE SPORK WAS A BAD CHOICE OF WEAPON.
I SHOULD HAVE TRAINED WITH THE KNIFE. OR THE FORK.
I AM A NINJA. I AM SUPPOSED TO BE INVISIBLE. I AM VERY VISIBLE.
MY STEALTH FAILED BECAUSE MY HEAD SQUEAKS.
GLUE MY SOLE BACK ON. PLEASE.
THE ODOR EATERS COULD NOT SAVE ME.
I AM TOE JAM NOW.
MY HEAD SMELLS LIKE FEET AND DEFEAT.
I WAS TRAINED FOR THIS FOR ELEVEN DAYS.
THE ONLINE NINJA COURSE DID NOT COVER THIS PART.
I WANT A REFUND ON MY BLACK BELT. IT WAS A SHOELACE.
MY BELT IS A SHOELACE. MY PRIDE IS A SHOELACE.
AIIIEEE. THAT IS NINJA FOR MY BUTT.
MY BUTT CHEEKS ARE NOW TWO SEPARATE CLANS.
SOMEBODY CHECK IF MY NADS ARE STILL LACED.
RIGHT IN THE HEEL. MY HEEL IS EVERYWHERE.
I FEEL LIKE A USED GYM SOCK.
THE GECKOS WILL LAUGH AT ME IN THE SEWER.
THE SEWER WATER IS IN MY HAT. IT IS ALSO IN MY MOUTH.
I SWALLOWED SEWER WATER. I AM BECOMING ONE OF THEM.
MY SHOE HAT IS FULL OF RAT.
THERE IS A RAT IN MY HAT AND HE IS JUDGING ME.
I HAVE BEEN BEATEN BY A FAMILY. MY CLAN WILL CHANGE MY NAME TO SLIPPER.
DEMOTED TO SANDAL.
DEMOTED TO FLIP-FLOP. THE LOWEST RANK.
THEY WILL MAKE ME WEAR CROCS NOW.
NOT THE CROCS. ANYTHING BUT THE CROCS.
THE REGIONAL SHOE MANAGER WILL TAKE MY SPORK.
I GOT KNOCKED OUT OF MY SOCKS. I WAS NOT WEARING SOCKS.
MY VELCRO IS UNDONE. MY LIFE IS UNDONE.
I AM SO SORRY, ANCESTORS. AND TO YOUR SHOES.
LACE ME UP AND BURY ME AT THE MALL.
MY FINAL WISH: A SHOE HORN. FOR REASONS.
THE SHOE IS ON THE OTHER FOOT. THE FOOT IS ON MY FACE.
MY FACE HAS A TREAD MARK NOW.
YOU KICKED MY HAT. THE HAT KICKED BACK. THE HAT LOST.
I DIE WITH MY BOOTS ON. ON MY HEAD.
THIS IS WHY MY MOM SAID SHOES GO ON FEET.
MY MOM WAS RIGHT ABOUT THE SHOES.
MY SHURIKEN WAS A BOTTLE CAP.
I THREW MY SMOKE BOMB. IT WAS A FART.
THAT SMOKE WAS NOT A SMOKE BOMB. SORRY.
MY NINJA VANISH WAS JUST ME FALLING DOWN.
THE TRAINING DUMMY WAS EASIER. IT DID NOT PUNCH.
I HAVE BEEN HUMBLED. AND SCUFFED.
SCUFFED. MY HEAD IS SCUFFED.
DO YOU HAVE A SHOE SHINE KIT? FOR MY SOUL?
TELL THE GRATER I AM GRATED.
I SURRENDER MY SNEAKERS TO THE SEWER GODS.
MY STINKY HAT GOES TO MY YOUNGEST BROTHER.
HE WILL NOT WANT IT. NOBODY WANTS IT.
THE STINK LINES ARE COMING FROM ME. NOT THE HAT. ME.
I WET MY NINJA PAJAMAS.
MY PAJAMAS RIPPED IN THE CROTCH. NINJAS DO NOT WEAR UNDERWEAR.
NOW YOU KNOW WHY NINJAS WEAR BLACK. THE STAINS.
I AM SHOOK. AND UNTIED.
MY HEAD HAS ATHLETE'S FOOT NOW.
THE SEWER CRED IS GONE.
I HAVE BEEN STOMPED BY A FAMILY. A WHOLE FAMILY.
MY SENSEI IS A SHOE SALESMAN NAMED GARY.
GARY WILL BE SO DISAPPOINTED.
I DID NOT EVEN GET TO DO MY COOL POSE.
MY COOL POSE TAKES FOUR MINUTES. YOU INTERRUPTED IT.
THAT IS NOT HOW YOU BOW.
I BOW TO YOU. FACE DOWN. IN THE SEWAGE.
SPORK NEVER AGAIN.
THE SPORK STABS ITS OWNER. LIKE THE PROPHECY SAID.
MY SPORK HAS BEEN USED ON A CUP OF NOODLES AND NOW ON ME.
SOMEONE TAKE MY SHOE OFF. MY HEAD NEEDS TO BREATHE.
MY EARS ARE SWEATING.
I HAVE BLISTERS ON MY BRAIN.
MY LACES ARE IN MY NOSE.
I CAN NO LONGER FEEL MY TOES. I HAVE NO TOES UP THERE.
THEY CALL ME THE SILENT ONE. AAAAAAAGH.
I AM NOT CRYING. MY HAT IS LEAKING.
THIS SHOE IS A KNOCKOFF. LIKE THIS WHOLE GAME.
THE CLAN MOTTO IS NEVER RETREAT. I AM RETREATING. FACE DOWN.
THE SOLE SURVIVOR IS NOT ME.
I REGRET EVERY SINGLE SHOELACE.
MY LEFT SHOE IS STILL FIGHTING. WITHOUT ME.
SEND MY SHOE TO A BETTER HEAD.
MY HAT CAME WITH A WARRANTY. IT DID NOT COVER YOU.
WHO TAUGHT A FAMILY TO FIGHT LIKE THAT? THE SEWER?
THE GECKOS WERE RIGHT ABOUT YOU. YOU ARE MEAN.
spawn: FROM THE SHADOWS. AND FROM THE SHOE RACK.
SMELL MY HAT AND FEAR ME.
THE SHOE CLAN SEES ALL. THROUGH THE LACE HOLES.
I AM SILENT. MY HAT SQUEAKS. IGNORE THE SQUEAK.
HAI-YAH! THAT IS ALL THE NINJA I KNOW.
THE SPORK SHALL TASTE YOUR SOUP.
BEHOLD THE ANCIENT ART OF STOMPING.
FEEL THE WRATH OF THE SOLE.
I HAVE COME FROM THE SEWER. YES, I SMELL LIKE IT.
I DO NOT WASH MY HAT. IT IS TRADITION.
OUR HATS ARE RENTED FROM THE BOWLING ALLEY.
LACE UP. IT IS GOING DOWN.
THE SEWER IS OUR DOJO. THE DOJO IS ALSO A TOILET.
I TRAINED FOR YEARS IN A PIPE. MY BACK IS BAD.
NO SHOES, NO SHIRT, NO MERCY.
WE STRIKE FROM THE PIPES. LIKE A CLOG.
I AM THE CLOG IN YOUR PIPE.
THE SHOE CLAN HAS ARRIVED. MIND THE DRIP.
SNEAK ATTACK! SQUEAK ATTACK!
THE REGIONAL SHOE MANAGER SENDS HIS REGARDS.
I WILL STOMP YOU LIKE A GRAPE. A LOUD GRAPE.
MY SPORK IS SHARP ON THE FORK SIDE.
TODAY YOU MEET THE TOE OF DOOM.
WE ATTACK FROM BELOW. LIKE A FOOT.
I SMELL A FAMILY. IT SMELLS BETTER THAN MY HAT.
MY HAT HAS A SPIRIT. THE SPIRIT IS ANGRY. AND DAMP.
ONE HUNDRED NINJAS. ONE HUNDRED HATS. ONE SMELL.
IN THE SEWER, NOBODY CAN HEAR YOU SQUEAK.
THE SEWER GECKOS CANNOT SAVE YOU. THEY ARE AT LUNCH.
THE SHADOW STRIKES. THE SHADOW IS SHAPED LIKE A SNEAKER.
BOW BEFORE THE SNEAKER.
THE FOOTWEAR PROPHECY IS UPON YOU.
MY STINK IS MY ARMOR.
WE ARE MANY. WE ARE DAMP.
THE GRATER PAYS US IN USED INSOLES.
MY HAT IS ON TIGHT. MY HEAD IS ON LOOSE.
SILENT AS A LEAF. A LEAF IN A SQUEAKY SNEAKER.
I HAVE NEVER LOST A FIGHT. I HAVE NEVER HAD A FIGHT.
TRAINEE NINJA REPORTING. PLEASE GO EASY. IT IS DAY ONE.
THE PIPES SAID YOU WOULD COME. THE PIPES ALSO SAY GLUG.
THE SHOE CLAN NEVER RETREATS. WE ONLY BACKPEDAL.
MY HAT IS A HIGH TOP. MY RANK IS HIGH TOO.
SNIFF THE AIR. THAT IS NINJA SCENT. IT IS FEET.
WE WALK IN THE SHADOWS. WE ALSO WALK IN THE SEWAGE.
I WILL SPORK YOU IN THE KIDNEY.
THE SOLE OF A NINJA IS ON HIS HEAD.
BEHOLD! THE STANCE OF THE SNEAKER!
TODAY I EARN MY VELCRO.
MY SENSEI SAYS THE SHOE MUST BE TIED BEFORE BATTLE. I CANNOT TIE IT. IT IS ON MY HEAD.
I CAME FROM THE PIPE. THE PIPE IS ANGRY. I AM ANGRY.
THE CLAN IS STRONG. THE CLAN IS DAMP.
FEAR THE SQUEAK. THE SQUEAK MEANS DEATH.
I AM A SENIOR LACE. RESPECT THE LACE.
WE ATTACK IN SILENCE. EXCEPT FOR THE SQUELCHING.
MY SHOE HAT HAS AN AIR BUBBLE IN THE HEEL. IT IS FULL OF RAGE.
WE ARE THE FEET OF THE NIGHT.
THE REGIONAL SHOE MANAGER IS WATCHING. LOOK SHARP. LOOK SHOE.
NINJA VANISH! I AM STILL HERE. NINJA VANISH! STILL HERE.
I LOST MY OTHER SHOE. MY BROTHER IS WEARING IT. ON HIS HEAD.
WE COME FROM THE SEWER AND WE ARE NOT SORRY.
